utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still only hearing rumors about the repair drive, nothing confirmed yet. Bo’s using the porch at 14 Maple for drop-offs and pickups, and I’ll let Kira and Faye know if I hear a start date or more details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I’ll make sure the neighbors I’ve already connected have the full details. And I’ll keep an ear out for the start date so we can firm things up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Mara — I appreciate that. I’ll keep asking around and pass along anything I hear about the start date or other details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll keep an eye out and send Rosa anything I spot that needs fixing on the block.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Bo — thanks for looking out. If we need a ladder, Mina can bring one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll let Rosa know if I see anything, and Mina’s ladder could come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll check for updates while I’m out running errands and let Oren know when I’m back. And Leo’s coming by after 2, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, Leo after 2. And you’ll check for updates while you’re out, then report back?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’ll check in while I’m out and let Oren know when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Jules is coordinating the repair drive, so once Tess hears a start date, let me know and Sam can sort the donations and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll keep an eye out for a wrench set, duct tape, and a ladder.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — that would be a huge help. I’ll wait for Tess’s update and then get Sam started on the sorting and labels.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help sort the donations and label the boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you confirm the time and drop-off spot before I head over? Kira asked about that too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can check that and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m thinking we start with the broken door and the leaky faucet first, then take care of the smaller fixes after that. Ira said she’ll check for updates while she’s out running errands and let us know when she’s back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep spreading the word and keep everyone posted on the plan. Rosa can keep organizing, and I’ll make sure the updates get around.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that really helps. I’ll stick with the door and faucet first, then I can circle back to the smaller fixes after that.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by late and help out. Keep it low-key, and let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine, Dane. We’re still starting with the broken door and leaky faucet this weekend, and the drop-off stays where we planned it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll come by late and keep it quiet. Just text me if the plan shifts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring my drill, hammer, wrench set, duct tape, and ladder for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great, Gus — I’ll spread the word and share any more details if I get them. Rosa said it’s for small fixes like loose hinges, leaky faucets, and squeaky doors, and Jules is keeping folks split by task.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the tools and help where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed the repair drive yet, so I want to check the details first. If we need a ladder, Mina can bring one.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, I’ll keep up with the updates on the repair drive. Let me know once the details are set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll confirm the details first and then let you know. If anything else comes up for the repair drive, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies for the repair drive. Rey’s checking for tape, spare screws, and any working wire.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’ll send the repair drive details to Pia so she can decide whether to come.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn. If Rey turns up anything, I’ll set it aside for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can look for tape and spare screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — if you find them, Bo can take the drop-off on the porch at 14 Maple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, I’ll leave them on the porch at 14 Maple if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep it low-key for now. Dane can sort the donations and swing by late if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works, Uli — low-key is fine, and I’ll keep it to Sunday at the community center. I’ll loop in the rest as needed and keep the plan steady.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Sunday at the community center works for me, and I appreciate you keeping it steady and quiet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like the timing and drop-off location confirmed before I head over. Once we know that, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll make sure everyone connected has the details as soon as they’re confirmed. Jules is also reaching out to a couple neighbors and passing along my info.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — I’ll wait for the confirmed timing and drop-off spot before I head over. Please let me know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can look for tape and spare screws for the repair drive. If you’ve got a wrench set, duct tape, or a ladder nearby, that’d help too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep everyone posted on the plan. Rosa’s still organizing it, and I’ll let Dane know to swing by late and help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye out for the tape and spare screws, and I’ll ask around for a ladder too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed the repair drive yet, but if we need a ladder, Mina can bring one. Bo can keep watch on the block, and Dane will sort the donations when he gets there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great — I’ll let Rosa know Bo’s keeping an eye out, and it’s good Mina can bring the ladder if needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I still need to confirm the repair drive, so I’ll check the details and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll keep an eye out and send Rosa anything I spot that needs fixing on the block.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep asking around, and if I hear a start date or any real details on the repair drive, I’ll let Kira and Faye know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: If Hana says we need a ladder, can you bring your tools by around 4 this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring the ladder and the rest of my tools by 4.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. I’ll check with Hana and let you know if we need the ladder.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center. Let me know if you hear of any little fixes we should add.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out and report anything that moves. Bo’s using the porch at 14 Maple for drop-offs and pickups, so I’ll note where each repair item ends up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — that helps a lot. I’ll keep Sunday at the community center as the main plan and make sure the details stay clear as items come in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, just keep it low-key for now. Dane can sort the donations, and if he needs to, he can swing by late.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, I’ll try to keep up with the updates on the plan. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. Just keep me posted quietly if the plan shifts at all.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together the repair drive for neighborhood fixes, and I can send the details over if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m out running errands, but I’ll check for updates and let Oren know when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — I’ll send the repair drive details your way, and feel free to pass them along to Oren when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’m starting with the broken door and the leaky faucet first, then I’ll tackle the smaller fixes after that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds like a solid plan, Oren. I’ll help sort the donations and label the boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, Tess—keep me posted and I’ll see what tools I can lend a hand with.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — I’m keeping an eye on the supplies. Rey’s checking for tape, spare screws, and any working wire for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — Sam can sort the donations and label the boxes, and Tess will let me know as soon as she hears a start date. If Hana says we need one, Mina can bring a ladder too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll keep tracking what we still need and make sure Rey’s finds get counted in. Thanks, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’ve heard about the repair drive, but do we have a date for it yet? Rosa’s still keeping the list updated, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa’s still keeping the list updated, yes. I’m still watching for a wrench set, duct tape, and a ladder.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so no date yet then? And Rosa’s still the one coordinating the volunteers?
